items.reason: A gentle, soothing gel that suits dry, sensitive-feeling skin and leaves it feeling calmer and more comfortable.

response.routine_note: Smooth the Centella Soothing Gel over clean skin morning and evening for a calming feel. Redness that comes on repeatedly with warmth or wine is best looked at by a dermatologist, as it is beyond what any shop product can address, so we have not added anything more.
